messages:
maya: Quick heads-up — the 'Troubleshooting: 429s & timeouts' page has several links that break when accessed from EU region (our linkcheck CI flagged them). Specifically the "Region-aware redirects" section links to https://eu.redwood.example.com/docs/429 which 301s to a blocked host. Can someone take this?

docs-bot: Linkcheck CI failed (check/links) — https://ci.redwood.example.com/builds/9876

lia: @maya can you paste the failing URL(s)? I can run a quick fix.

maya: failing ones:
- https://eu.redwood.example.com/docs/429
- https://eu.redwood.example.com/sdk/python#retry

tomas: probable cause: we added region prefix in nginx but docs hosting sends absolute links to canonical host. Short fix: change links to relative or to /docs/429. Also update snippet showing SDK retry to show parsing Retry-After header correctly for 429s.

samir: i'll open a tiny PR to convert those absolute eu urls to relative ones + add a note about EU redirect behaviour. PR in a minute.

jeff: +1. Also can we add a short code snippet for SDK clients showing parse of Retry-After (seconds or http-date)? Many customers hit 429s and expect both formats.

maya: here's a suggested snippet (python):
```python
# parse Retry-After
from email.utils import parsedate_to_datetime
import time

def retry_after_seconds(header):
    try:
        return int(header)
    except ValueError:
        dt = parsedate_to_datetime(header)
        return max(0, int((dt.timestamp() - time.time())))
```

lia: perfect. i'll include that in PR and add a line about fallback behavior when Retry-After missing (exponential backoff).

docs-bot: PR #2472 opened by samir: https://github.com/redwood-inference/docs/pull/2472 — link patch + retry snippet

maya: thanks. assign to @lia for review. Once merged, i'll run linkcheck in EU staging and ping infra to redeploy docs cache.

tomas: quick note for release: update release-notes snippet so we don't accidentally reintroduce absolute host links during i18n export.

samir: noted. i'll add a changelog entry.

jeff: will QA in eu-staging after merge. ETA tomorrow morning PST.

maya: awesome — closing the loop here. :thumbsup:
